name: Filter
description: Frequency response of a filter with a vector network analyzer (VNA): insertion loss, the cut-off or band edges at -3 dB below the peak, bandwidth, centre frequency and Q, passband ripple, the depth of a notch, the gain at chosen frequencies, group delay, and a pass / fail check against a mask. For low-pass, high-pass, band-pass and band-stop filters. The VNA is calibrated beforehand by the user.

roles.name: vna
roles.description: The network analyzer, calibrated for the connection of the filter between port 1 and port 2

filter.description: type (lowpass|highpass|bandpass|bandstop), label (identifies the filter) and asset_id (its code in the registry)

sweep.description: start_hz, stop_hz, points, scale (linear|log), if_bandwidth_hz, power_dbm

edge_db.description: the cut-off / band edges are where the gain is this far below the peak (3 by default)

passband.description: from_hz and to_hz: where the ripple is measured, and the level the edges refer to

frequencies_of_interest.description: the gain is reported at these frequencies

limits.description: pass / fail mask on the gain in dB (negative numbers): {"bands": [{"from": 0, "to": 1e9, "min": -1}, {"from": 2e9, "to": 3e9, "max": -40}]}

also_s11.description: also read S11 to report the return loss in the passband

confirm_setup.description: ask, before measuring, to calibrate and connect the filter
